items.html:
Technically one of the best and hardest working batsman in the Netherlands
side. Should be able to convert this hard work into some big scores. Has the
ability to bat at any position but personally prefers opening. A very good
and quick fielder within the inner circle. He is still developing his off
spinners and is known to break a batting partnership when needed (KNCB 2003)
